target: Replace the falsified merged-tail binary-origin reduction with an exact classification of every graph-theoretic route by which one legal Resolution step can create an unsafe acyclic low-rank clause.

falsified_hypothesis.name: Merged-Tail Binary-Origin Reduction as a pure graph theorem

minimum_abstract_witness.effect: The shared literal 0->1 becomes a bridge, but the resolvent remains component-spanning.

falsified_hypothesis.interpretation: Bridge birth is not equivalent to graphic-rank loss. Binary origin and two-component localization are stronger than required for safety.

proved_graph_theorems.name: Internal-Parent Preservation
proved_graph_theorems.statement: If one parent is internal-only, the external quotient graph of the other parent survives unchanged because the pivot is internal in both.

proved_graph_theorems.name: Cycle/Cycle Closure
proved_graph_theorems.statement: Two directed-cycle parents resolve to a clause containing a directed cycle: a pivot-avoiding cycle survives, or two opposite pivot-deleted directed paths form a directed closed walk.

proved_graph_theorems.name: Spanning/Cycle Closure
proved_graph_theorems.statement: A component-spanning parent and a directed-cycle parent resolve to a component-spanning clause or a directed-cycle clause.

proved_graph_theorems.name: Spanning/Spanning Exact Obstruction
proved_graph_theorems.statement: An unsafe acyclic low-rank resolvent from two component-spanning parents requires an external pivot that is a bridge in both parents and induces the same undirected quotient cut in both.

exact_unsafe_route.note: The first four conditions are the unique graph-rank route. A surviving directed cycle still makes a same-cut resolvent safe.

finite_gt_evidence.fresh_parent_class_observation: All 77 finite fresh occurrences use one component-spanning and one directed-cycle parent.
finite_gt_evidence.claim_boundary: These counts do not prove the arbitrary-n GT same-cut exclusion.

corrected_remaining_local_gate.name: GT Same-Cut Double-Bridge Exclusion
corrected_remaining_local_gate.statement: For arbitrary n, no parent-eligible pre-frontier reachable GT residual contains two component-spanning clauses with complementary pivot bridges inducing the same quotient cut.
corrected_remaining_local_gate.sufficient_strengthening: Every co-resolvable double-bridge pair is tail-singleton in both parents; complementary orientations then isolate opposite endpoints and have different cuts.

falsification_conditions: Produce a legal Resolution with a cycle-bearing or internal-only parent whose resolvent is unsafe acyclic low-rank.
Produce an unsafe resolvent from two spanning parents where the pivot is not a same-cut double bridge.
Produce a reachable pre-frontier GT same-cut complementary double-bridge pair.
Produce a surviving singleton-tail lineage that merges its tail before the root shield becomes effective.
Map exponentially many historical frontier restrictions to polynomially many exact Policy-0A cache states without an equivalent charged event.
claim_boundary: This amendment proves the exact one-inference quotient-graph classification. It does not prove the arbitrary-n GT same-cut exclusion, the global Policy-0A lower bound, or P versus NP.
